mentions.name: Font of Web
mentions.description: A free collection of 4,363 real website design snippets captured from 544 domains. For every design it extracts the exact fonts used on the page (561 unique font families found so far), the precise color palette, and a direct link to the live site, serving as a practical design inspiration resource.
mentions.problem: Inspiration sites like Dribbble are full of polished mockups that aren't practical, and award-style sites don't represent the mundanity of most real websites.
